memberdef.name: APFLOAT_DISPATCH_ON_SEMANTICS
memberdef.initializer: do { \ if (usesLayout<IEEEFloat>(getSemantics())) \ return U.IEEE.METHOD_CALL; \ if (usesLayout<DoubleAPFloat>(getSemantics())) \ return U.Double.METHOD_CALL; \ llvm_unreachable("Unexpected semantics"); \ } while (false)

briefdescription.para: This file declares a class to represent arbitrary precision floating point values and provide a variety of arithmetic operations on them.
